dispatch_rule: Check live cloud completed ledger and Bridges output/scheduler immediately before dispatch. Successful matching cells are reused; failed/partial or differing-count/profile cells remain distinct. Never cancel pending jobs automatically. Older predictor/judge results remain archived; no repeat until canonical controls and variant review justify it.
